name: muxmender-vscode
description: Run safe MuxMender dry-run scans in a dedicated VS Code Output channel.

commands.title: MuxMender: Test HDR Delivery (10 Seconds, Safe Copy)
MuxMender: Preview Dolby Vision Color (Safe Native Test)
MuxMender: Optimize Selected Media File (Safe Copy)

muxmender.nativeHelperPath.description: Optional muxmender-dv-preview.exe in an extracted native runtime. Adjacent DLLs and color-test helper are required.

muxmender.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run MuxMender.

muxmender.scriptPath.description: Optional absolute path to muxmender.py. The active workspace is searched when empty.

muxmender.ffmpegPath.description: FFmpeg executable name or absolute path. Use a Full build for Dolby Vision previews.

muxmender.ffprobePath.description: FFprobe executable name or absolute path.

enumDescriptions: Prefer a detected GPU and offer CPU if it fails.
Require Intel Quick Sync hardware encoding.
Preserve every source video's exact dimensions.
muxmender.resolution.description: Resolution policy. Preserves aspect ratio and never upscales.

enumDescriptions: Block Dolby Vision processing and report why.
Permit only bit-for-bit video copying into MKV; Dolby Vision re-encoding remains blocked.
